title: The result from `getSwapOutput` is inaccurate to be used as the `minOutput` in the swap operation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low, because it decrease the `minOutput` by 0.02%  **Likelihood:** High, because it always happened when `harvest` is called.  ## Description  When `harvest` called, it will calculate `quote` amount that will be used for `minOutput` in the swap operation by calling `router.getSwapOutput`  ```solidity function harvest() external {     // ...     // Fetching the quote onchain means that we're subject to front/back-running but the     // assumption is that we will harvest so frequently that the rewards won't justify the effort. >>  (uint256 index, uint256 quote) = router.
